resources.string: LikeFlow watches TikTok only while it is open and auto-scroll is switched on in the LikeFlow app. It reads TikTok\'s playback progress (from the screen or TikTok\'s accessibility information) to tell when a video has finished, then performs one upward swipe to move to the next video. Everything is processed on your phone. Nothing is stored or sent anywhere, and LikeFlow never sees your TikTok password or account.
The app will monitor TikTok only while it is open and auto-scroll is enabled.
Turn on the LikeFlow accessibility service to begin.
Switch on auto-scroll below, then open your Liked videos in TikTok.
Open TikTok, go to Profile → Liked, and tap the first video.
LikeFlow can\'t read this video\'s playback progress, so it won\'t swipe. Try a longer video (TikTok shows its progress bar more often on those), or check the diagnostics below.
Found progress via %1$s. Making sure it moves steadily before trusting it.
Tracking via %1$s. Will swipe once when the video finishes.
Tracking via %1$s. Dry run: will log the finish without swiping.
Letting the next video settle before checking again.
If Android says the setting is restricted (common for apps installed from an APK), open App info, tap ⋮, choose \"Allow restricted settings\", then try again.
TikTok doesn\'t appear to be installed.
Read playback progress when available and check for the end-of-video transition.
Perform one upward swipe when completion is detected.
No TikTok password, account connection, or external server is required.
Use this first to check whether your phone exposes TikTok\'s playback progress reliably.
Uses accessibility screenshots, analysed on the phone and then discarded.
Needs Android 11 or later. On this phone LikeFlow can only use TikTok\'s accessibility data.
When no progress is exposed, compare frames to spot the video restarting. Can miss loops; may misfire on very repetitive videos.

1. Enable LikeFlow in Accessibility settings.
2. Switch on auto-scroll (try dry run first).
3. In TikTok, open Profile → Liked and tap the first video.
4. Leave TikTok on screen. LikeFlow pauses whenever you leave TikTok.
Prototype. TikTok may loop a video instead of reporting that it finished, so LikeFlow waits whenever it can\'t confidently detect completion. Not affiliated with TikTok.
